categories.main_business_segments: Foosung Co., Ltd operates primarily in the production and sale of fluorochemical basic compounds and chemical engineering equipment. Its key product lines include refrigerants, secondary battery materials (notably lithium hexafluorophosphate - LiPF6), inorganic fluorides, and semiconductor specialty gases. Additionally, through its subsidiary Hantech, it manufactures chemical engineering equipment such as heat exchangers, pressure vessels, and storage tanks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 40 years of accumulated fluorochemical technology and advanced process know-how. It specializes in high-purity fluorochemical synthesis, including semiconductor-grade anhydrous hydrogen fluoride and crystallization processes to control particle size for battery electrolytes. Hantech utilizes advanced design and manufacturing capabilities for carbon steel, stainless steel, and difficult-to-process non-ferrous metals like titanium, zirconium, and tantalum in chemical equipment production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Foosung serves leading domestic and international customers including Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, major home appliance manufacturers, semiconductor producers, and electrolyte makers. Its products are used across automotive, steel, semiconductor, construction, and environmental industries. The company targets markets for refrigerants, secondary battery electrolytes, semiconductor etching and deposition gases, and chemical plant equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in South Korea (Ulsan) and China (Nantong), with sales and exports to global markets. Its overseas subsidiaries in China and Poland support manufacturing and distribution. The company’s customer base spans domestic Korean industries and international markets, particularly in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Foosung operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, manufacturing specialized fluorochemical intermediates and materials used by downstream manufacturers in electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors. It also produces chemical engineering equipment used in upstream and midstream chemical processing plants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in next-generation refrigerants, high-purity lithium battery electrolytes, semiconductor specialty gases, and environmentally friendly products. It invests in scaling production capacity for LiPF6 and C4F6 gases, develops new electrolyte additives, and pursues product localization and import substitution. Foosung emphasizes innovation to maintain technological leadership and expand global market share.
categories.revenue_model: Foosung generates revenue primarily through the sale of chemical products including refrigerants, battery materials, inorganic fluorides, and semiconductor gases, as well as chemical engineering equipment. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with large industrial customers and through a nationwide dealer network. Revenue is recognized from product sales domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Foosung holds a leading domestic position as the sole or dominant manufacturer of key fluorochemical products such as LiPF6 and semiconductor specialty gases in South Korea. It competes globally with a few major players in high-value semiconductor gases and battery materials. Its subsidiary Hantech is recognized as a top-tier chemical equipment manufacturer with unique capabilities in difficult metal fabrication.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Foosung reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 523 billion, reflecting a 14.3% decline from the previous year due to global economic uncertainties and reduced demand in battery and semiconductor sectors. The company experienced an operating loss of KRW 46 billion in 2023, reversing prior profitability. Total assets stood at KRW 853 billion with liabilities of KRW 522 billion, indicating a moderate leverage profile. The company is investing in capacity expansions to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Foosung differentiates itself through proprietary fluorochemical technologies, high-purity product quality, and a strong domestic market monopoly in critical materials like LiPF6 and semiconductor gases. Its long-standing expertise and advanced manufacturing processes enable it to meet stringent environmental regulations and customer specifications. The company’s integrated chemical and equipment manufacturing capabilities provide comprehensive solutions to key industrial sectors, enhancing customer value and competitive advantage.
